This '''weapons depot''' was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], near the main Republic command center, and was used to house new experimental weapons.

==History==
During the [[Krath/Legends|Krath's]] [[Battle of Coruscant (Great Sith War)|invasion of Coruscant]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Mandalore the Indomitable]] and his [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] temporarily captured the depot, and managed to steal the experimental [[MX]] weapon.
